reviews.text:
For the past 5 years, my little big beast, Saké (toy poodle), has been cared for/tamed(!) by the great expertise of Elisabete & company.
In short: Excellent bathing and grooming service.
Well done!
They were very friendly and my Jubas looked beautiful! ❤️❤️❤️

I booked a full wash and cut service for the first time for my Maltese. I was truly happy I made this choice. Two very sweet, attentive, and welcoming ladies took care of every detail to avoid stress for my elderly dog ​​with heart disease, who for the first time in 14 years refused to leave. The cut and grooming were perfect; they know the Maltese breed well and are truly professional. Furthermore, the salon is clean, spacious, and cool, which is crucial to prevent the dog from panting at the end of the treatment. We will definitely be back and can recommend it 100/100.
The best place to take care of your pet's fur. High-quality products and service, very professional and with great empathy for animals. I recommend them and will always return!

Lovely people who offer an amazing service and are so good to the dog ❤️ I loved our experience at a tosquiaria and can recommend so much. They knew all about the Pomeranian and my dog got the best haircut she ever had. Thank you
I love taking my dog ​​to Beth, she's very careful and Pipo loves it!

I went there this morning, and I’m writing this review tonight because I still can’t quite believe it.
I have a 14-year-old Persian cat; his coat is like feathers, very fine but quite dense; it gets very tangled and, until today, it was so difficult to brush that he had become gato-non-grata at the many grooming salons I took him to, which could probably have filed a complaint for attempted murder.

And tonight, my cat looks like a beautiful unicorn;
everything went smoothly, with respect and gentleness.

A miracle !

I took my cat to the groomer for the first time.
All the knots were removed, her ears were cleaned, and her nails were trimmed, all at a super affordable price.
They've definitely gained a customer!
Took my very nervous senior dog here for grooming and nail clipping and they did a wonderful job. Fully recommend for all creatures.
Very pleasant space, and excellent professionals with a lot of patience, they managed to groom a boy with a special temperament 😉 I recommend them 100%. Thank you very much 🙏 …

Look, I can't understand how A Tosquiaria manages to get such a positive rating. The workers are unfriendly, rude, and have zero sensitivity towards animals. My dog, who has no stress or agitation, comes back from A Tosquiaria as if she'd been in Vietnam. I'd find it normal, since some dogs don't like grooming, but I've paid for services at several pet shops in Lisbon, and my pet has never come back even close to being like that. I've seen many dogs being pulled roughly and held by the neck while I wait the remaining 5 minutes to get my dog ​​out. I only expect attention to this from everyone. And I also hope I'm the only one who has suffered this kind of problem.
Very positive approach from the staff, qualitative work, I am very satisfied

Elizabete and her team are the best. I have taken my little dog  (she means everything to me) here many times and every time the service has been just perfect. They pay attention to detail, my little girl is not stressed at all when her service is over which is very important to me. Highly recommended!

I'm a colleague from GREECE and I really wanted to see a place here in Portugal 🇵🇹! We just flew in on a day off and it was closed! Maybe another time!! Good job!
@groomology_athens 💪🏼💪🏼🐶🐾🐩
